name: Urad Dal with Lauki
ingredients: ¼ cup (50 g) split urad dal (dhuli), rinsed
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp coriander powder
steps: Pressure-cook the urad dal with the lauki, turmeric and 2 cups water for 3 whistles until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and coriander powder and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the dal and lauki, mash lightly, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice, salt and coriander.
note: Lauki adds volume and moisture, so you can use less dal per serving.
